connections.travel_description: A ferry and coastal road connect the capital river docks to the Greywater Coast.
The inland road returns from the coast toward the capital.
The southern gate road leaves the capital for the Verdant March.
The old trade road returns north toward the capital.
A sealed pilgrimage route descends beneath the cathedral into the Hollow Under.
A guarded lift returns travelers to the cathedral foundations.
An old scholarly expedition route leads toward the Sunken Archive.
The flooded causeway leads back toward the scholars of the capital.
The eastern road becomes the military Iron Road beyond the hills.
The Iron Road returns west into the Verdant March.
A dangerous mining caravan route crosses the dry interior toward the Blackglass Desert.
The caravan route leads back toward the Ironbound mines.
A hidden mountain route rises from the desert toward the Skygrave.
A buried route descends from the mountains into the Blackglass Desert.
